description: Corrections to the Swahili source texts, kept here so a rebuild applies them again. <TRANSLATION>.<book>.<chapter> replaces a whole chapter; strip.<TRANSLATION>["book:chapter:verse"] removes stray text; replace.<TRANSLATION>["book:chapter:verse"] is a list of [as printed, corrected]; bookNames.<TRANSLATION>[book] is the name shown in place of the source's running head.

replace.description: The ULB marks three asides with braces, which elsewhere are markup; they are written as round brackets, and the stray space inside the closing one taken out.

bookNames.description: ULB (SWU) running heads written without the space after the number (1Samweli, 1Wafalme, 1Timotheo), one with a stray chapter number (1Yohana 1), and two shortened where the other books are short: Torati as Kumbukumbu la Torati (the usual name), Waraka wa Yakobo as Yakobo, like the other letters.
